new_paragraphs: How much does a private chef cost in Dubai Marina?
Private dining in Dubai Marina starts from about AED 700–950 per person, depending on guest count, menu and service level. Larger groups come down per head; send your numbers for an exact quote.
Which parts of Dubai Marina do you serve?
All of Dubai Marina — Marina Walk apartment towers, waterfront penthouses and the surrounding streets — plus nearby Dubai communities. Confirm your exact address when you enquire.
What's included?
From menu planning to the chef, the service staff, the plating and the cleanup — one team covers all of it.
How do I book?
Share your date, guest count and address; we match a vetted chef and send an itemised proposal, usually within one business day.
Can you cook on a yacht chartered from Dubai Marina?

Yes. We build on-board menus that travel and plate well at sea, and the chef works around the galley you have. Share the berth, the boat and the number aboard and we plan the day around your itinerary.
Do you cater a Dubai Marina dinner party or larger event?

Yes — from an intimate dinner party for two to a penthouse party or event for forty. Dubai Marina event catering scales with plated menus, buffets or canapé receptions, and we bring the service staff to match.
Is halal and allergen-aware catering available in Dubai Marina?

Yes. Fully halal menus are standard, and vegetarian and vegan dishes are built in. Gluten-free, nut-conscious and other dietary menu options may be available on request, subject to confirmation by the assigned culinary partner. Partner kitchens may handle allergens, and cross-contact cannot be completely excluded unless dedicated controls have been specifically confirmed for the booking. Guests with allergies must provide full details before confirming their event.
How far ahead should I book a personal chef in Dubai Marina?
A week or two gives the most menu freedom, but we take shorter-notice bookings when a chef is free. Send your date early and we confirm availability, usually within one business day.
Can I request a female private chef in Dubai Marina?

Yes — a female chef can be requested for your booking. Tell us when you enquire and myCHEF matches you with a female chef from the partner network for your date, cuisine and service style. In Dubai Marina the request usually comes from family apartments, women-only celebrations and yacht days where the host wants the galley kept private. Say so with your date rather than after the menu is agreed, because availability moves with the date, the cuisine and who in the partner network is free.
For private chef marina, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .
